items.title: 美國9月CPI年升3.7%略高預期 美股指數期貨短線走跌
items.title_en: US September CPI rises 3.7% YoY, slightly above expectations; US stock index futures dip short‑term
paras: 美國勞工統計局(BLS)周三(14日)公布數據顯示，9月消費者物價指數(CPI)年升3.7%，高於市場預期的3.6%，前值3.4%；按月來看成長0.6%，符合市場預期的0.6%，前值0.4%。數據公布後，美元指數短線拉升約30點，美股期貨短線走低
剔除能源和食品等波動較大因素後的核心CPI在9月年增2.6%，高於市場預期的2.5%，前值2.4%；按月來看成長0.3%，預期0.2%，前值0.3%。
截稿前，美元指數短線拉升約30點，現報102.52。美股期貨短線走低，三大股指期貨均轉跌。美國10年期公債殖利率短線拉升，現報5.189%。現貨黃金短線走低約30美元，現報4128.60美元/盎司。
持續更新...
paras_en: The U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) released data on Wednesday (the 14th) showing that the September Consumer Price Index (CPI) rose 3.7% year‑over‑year, above the market forecast of 3.6% and up from a prior 3.4%; on a month‑to‑month basis it increased 0.6%, matching the 0.6% expectation and up from 0.4%. After the release, the dollar index jumped about 30 points in the short term, while U.S. stock futures fell briefly.

Core CPI, which excludes volatile items such as energy and food, rose 2.6% year‑over‑year in September, higher than the 2.5% market expectation and up from 2.4% previously; on a monthly basis it grew 0.3%, versus a 0.2% forecast and unchanged from the prior 0.3%.

At the time of writing, the dollar index was up roughly 30 points, trading at 102.52. U.S. stock futures were lower, with all three major index futures turning negative. The yield on the 10‑year U.S. Treasury rose, now at 5.189%. Spot gold slipped about $30, priced at $4,128.60 per ounce.
Updates will continue to be provided.

items.title: 高盛看好亞太區人工智慧與市場動能 稱北亞與印度迎資本支出浪潮
items.title_en: Goldman Sachs Optimistic on AI and Market Momentum in Asia-Pacific, Says North Asia and India Face Capital‑Spending Surge
paras: 高盛集團亞太區(日本除外)總裁Kevin Sneader指出，受到人工智慧基礎建設支出的帶動，日本、印度與中國等亞太市場正展現出強勁的發展動能。
Sneader指出，北亞地區是AI相關資本支出的主要受惠者。針對外界認為印度因缺乏本土大語言模型而處於劣勢的說法，Sneader予以反駁，並透露高盛已在印度交易所識別出42家「AI賦能者」(AI enablers)上市公司，其市場表現整體成長約60%。
Sneader於彭博新經濟論壇期間強調：「印度是我們所稱的『AI賦能者』所在地。」
他補充稱，印度有高達42%的農業領域具備導入AI轉型的空間，代表著極具潛力的長期機遇；高盛於去年在孟買開設了全新的辦事處。
談及中國市場，Sneader坦言目前總體經濟形勢較為複雜，雖然國內消費較為疲軟，但強勁的製造業與科技領域抵銷了部分衝擊，高盛打算繼續積極參與。他明確表示：「我們相信交易仍在繼續，我們希望成為其中的一部分。」
Sneader認為，儘管在中美貿易環境下身為美資機構，但這並非無法克服的障礙，全球第二大經濟體仍為客戶導向的業務提供廣闊空間。
此外，Sneader提到香港的首次公開發行(IPO)市場仍保持動能。他對於加強IPO定價監管審查表示歡迎，直言透明度與清晰度才是關鍵，並指出更嚴格的標準最終將為市場定位良好的企業帶來更多商機。
至於AI對高盛自身人力配置的影響，Sneader表示目前的招聘仍保持廣泛，並認為「要預測AI將如何重塑人力結構還言之過早」，同時重申高盛將持續恪守成本控管原則。
paras_en: Goldman Sachs Asia‑Pacific (excluding Japan) President Kevin Sneader said that AI infrastructure spending is driving strong development momentum in Asia‑Pacific markets such as Japan, India and China.

Sneader noted that North Asia is the primary beneficiary of AI‑related capital spending. He rebutted the view that India is at a disadvantage because it lacks a domestic large‑language model, and disclosed that Goldman has identified 42 publicly listed “AI enablers” on Indian exchanges, whose market performance has risen about 60% overall.
During Bloomberg’s New Economy Forum, Sneader emphasized: “India is where we find our ‘AI enablers.’”
He added that up to 42% of India’s agriculture sector has scope for AI‑driven transformation, representing a highly promising long‑term opportunity; Goldman opened a new office in Mumbai last year.

Commenting on the Chinese market, Sneader admitted that the overall economic backdrop is complex – domestic consumption is weak, but robust manufacturing and technology sectors offset some of the impact, and Goldman plans to stay actively involved. He said, “We believe transactions are still happening and we want to be part of them.”

Sneader said that, despite being a U.S.‑owned firm operating in the Sino‑U.S. trade environment, this is not an insurmountable obstacle and that the world’s second‑largest economy still offers ample space for client‑focused business.

He also mentioned that Hong Kong’s IPO market remains vibrant. He welcomed tighter IPO pricing oversight, stating that transparency and clarity are key, and noted that stricter standards will ultimately bring more opportunities to well‑positioned companies.

Regarding AI’s impact on Goldman’s own staffing, Sneader said hiring remains broad and that “it is too early to predict how AI will reshape the workforce,” while reaffirming the firm’s commitment to disciplined cost control.

items.title: 金管會攜銀行公會創新金融！彭金隆提3大期許 加速穩定幣與虛擬資產整合
items.title_en: Financial Supervisory Commission Teams Up with Bankers Association for Innovative Finance! Peng Jin‑long Sets Three Major Expectations to Accelerate Stablecoin and Virtual Asset Integration
paras: 銀行公會第15屆第2次會員代表大會於今（14）日登場，由銀行公會理事長董瑞斌主持，金管會主委彭金隆特別蒞臨致詞。彭金隆在會中高度肯定銀行公會扮演政府與產業溝通橋樑，並對金融業提出三大期許，強調今年前8個月整體銀行業獲利優異，但面對全球經濟不確定性，銀行業應在晴天時廣積糧，持續強化資本強韌度，同時推動信任金融與全齡金融，並落實外部引進與內部培育的雙軌人才戰略，以迎接台灣金融產業高度成長的需要。
彭金隆致詞時首先表達感謝，指出面對國內外經濟劇烈變動與新興科技帶來的挑戰，銀行公會長期全力支持金管會推動各項政策，特別是在協助亞洲資產管理中心專區的私人銀行、家族辦公室及OBU財富管理業務三大工作坊運作上成果顯著，順利推動家族辦公室在台灣落地，為後續法規調適與業務全面推廣打下堅實基礎。
在防詐政策與實體經濟支持方面，彭金隆表示，感謝銀行第一線同仁在阻詐防詐上的無私付出，銀行管理層應給予第一線從業人員最大的支持與鼓勵。此外，目前金融機構對中小企業的放款目標已提前順利達標，期許各銀行未來持續積極協助中小企業發展。針對金融科技與數位轉型，他感謝公會協助研擬穩定幣發行及管理授權子法的建議條文，協助建立穩定幣與虛擬資產的基本監理架構，期待未來能進一步整合傳統金融與區塊鏈金融。
面對金融業未來發展，彭金隆對整體銀行業提出三大明確期許。首先是強化資本結構與資本強韌度，彭金隆指出，今年前8個月整體銀行獲利表現超越前兩年，但在榮景之下更要提高風險意識，銀行業者必須在晴天時廣積糧，持續增強資本結構，唯有資本足夠強大，才能從容因應未來經濟高度成長與潛在市場波動的需要。
其次是推動信任金融、金融大回饋及全齡金融，彭金隆認為銀行擁有良好的經營績效後，應當積極回饋社會、深化社會信任，未來主管機關在金融政策上將有更大幅度的開放，並會持續檢討現行金融服務範圍，儘可能滿足不同族群的需求，尋找新的發展契機。
最後則是全力培養與吸引人才，彭金隆強調，銀行業務的成長完全取決於人才，市場成長必須人才先行，銀行應採用外部引進與內部培育並重的雙軌策略，除了深化本土培育，更要積極吸引國外優秀金融人才，藉此全面提升台灣金融業的國際競爭力。
董瑞斌回應表示，隨著國際經濟與金融情勢快速變化，銀行業面臨的挑戰日趨嚴峻。為配合政策推動台灣成為亞洲資產管理中心，公會已持續研議各項配套措施，修正銀行高資產客戶財富管理業務實務參考文件，並舉辦產業論壇，朝打造具台灣特色的資產管理中心邁進。因應人工智慧與新興科技發展，公會已修訂金融機構運用人工智慧技術作業規範，研提穩定幣授權子法可行建議，並完成量子科技對台灣金融業影響的研究報告。
針對金融安全與防詐，公會協助研擬ATM存入控管措施、修正疑似洗錢交易態樣，並配合研修詐欺犯罪危害防制條例相關子法，透過金檢警跨業聯防與臨櫃關懷，全力守護民眾財產安全。在誠信文化方面，也已研訂銀行業行為與文化管理指引，確保產業穩健經營。
paras_en: The 15th term, 2nd meeting of the Bankers Association’s member representatives was held today (the 14th), chaired by Association chairman Dong Ruibin, with Financial Supervisory Commission (FSC) Chairperson Peng Jin‑long delivering a special address. Peng praised the Association’s role as a bridge between government and industry, and laid out three key expectations for the financial sector, noting that banks posted strong profits in the first eight months of the year but must, amid global economic uncertainty, build reserves in good times, keep strengthening capital resilience, promote trustworthy and all‑age finance, and implement a dual‑track talent strategy of external recruitment and internal development to meet Taiwan’s rapid financial‑industry growth needs.

Peng began his remarks by thanking the Association, pointing out that amid volatile domestic and overseas economies and challenges from emerging technologies, the Bankers Association has consistently supported the FSC’s policy initiatives. He highlighted the Association’s notable contributions to the Asian Asset Management Center’s private‑banking, family‑office and OBU wealth‑management workshops, which have successfully anchored family offices in Taiwan and laid a solid foundation for subsequent regulatory adjustments and broader business rollout.

Regarding anti‑fraud measures and support for the real economy, Peng expressed gratitude for frontline bank staff’s selfless efforts in fraud prevention and urged bank management to give them maximum support and encouragement. He noted that financial institutions have already met their loan‑disbursement targets for SMEs ahead of schedule and called on banks to continue actively assisting SME development. On fintech and digital transformation, he thanked the Association for helping draft the stablecoin issuance and management authorization sub‑law provisions, which establish a basic supervisory framework for stablecoins and virtual assets, and he looks forward to deeper integration of traditional finance with blockchain finance.

Looking ahead, Peng set three clear expectations for the banking sector. First, to strengthen capital structure and resilience. He observed that while banks’ profit performance in the first eight months surpassed that of the previous two years, the sector must heighten risk awareness, stockpile reserves in good times, and continuously enhance capital adequacy so it can comfortably handle future high‑growth economies and market volatility.

Second, to promote trustworthy finance, major financial give‑backs and all‑age finance. Peng argued that once banks achieve solid performance, they should give back to society and deepen public trust. He said regulators will further open up financial policies and continuously review the scope of financial services to meet the needs of diverse groups and seek new development opportunities.

Third, to fully cultivate and attract talent. Peng emphasized that the growth of banking services depends entirely on talent; market expansion must be talent‑driven. Banks should adopt a dual‑track strategy of external recruitment and internal development, deepening local talent pipelines while actively attracting outstanding overseas financial professionals to boost Taiwan’s international competitiveness.

Dong Ruibin responded that rapid changes in the global economy and financial landscape are intensifying challenges for banks. To align with policies positioning Taiwan as an Asian asset‑management hub, the Association has been formulating supporting measures, revising practical reference documents for wealth‑management services to high‑net‑worth clients, and hosting industry forums to build a Taiwan‑characteristic asset‑management centre. In response to AI and emerging technologies, the Association has updated guidelines for AI use by financial institutions, proposed feasible stablecoin authorization sub‑law recommendations, and completed a research report on the impact of quantum technology on Taiwan’s financial sector.

Regarding financial security and fraud prevention, the Association helped draft ATM deposit control measures, revised suspicious money‑laundering transaction patterns, and collaborated on sub‑law development for the Fraud Crime Prevention Act. Through cross‑industry cooperation among the FSC, police and banks and on‑site customer care, it aims to protect the public’s assets. In terms of integrity culture, it has also formulated behavioral and cultural management guidelines for banks to ensure the industry’s sound operation.

items.title: 〈智慧能源週〉台塑新智能攜手綠捷跨足機器狗電池開發 彰濱二期廠力拚2028年Q2量產
items.title_en: Smart Energy Week: Formosa Plastics' New Intelligence Partners with GreenTech to Develop Robot Dog Batteries, Changbin Phase‑II Aims for Q2 2028 Mass Production
paras: 台塑新智能今 (2026) 年以「全域能源，驅動AI未來」為主題參加台灣國際智慧能源周，聚焦AI資料中心(AIDC)應用，此次展出高倍率電池即針對AIDC備援需求開發，彰濱二期正規劃新增5GWh(百萬瓩時)電芯，估逾2028年第2季量產。台塑新智能總經理劉慧啟表示，公司與中華汽車(2204-TW)子綠捷合作開發機器狗專用電池，正進行測試，預計明(2027)年通過認證落地。
台塑(1301-TW)集團轉投資子公司台塑新智能已連續3年參展，今年聚焦AIDC電池應用，從電池切入，進一步拓展至AI伺服器機房系統整合及CSP(雲端服務)與營運管理，展現橫跨能源設備、工程建置與營運服務的AIDC事業。
劉惠啟說，發展AI一定需要算力，連政府都倡導算力即國力，但沒有電力就沒有算力，加上儲能已成為關鍵戰略物資，面對全球AIDC的建置潮，此次展出90V50Ah高倍率電池，最高可支援8C連續放電，目前已導入台中的半導體大廠中的AIDC備援系統。
同時，配合集團公司記憶體大廠南亞科(2408-TW)的儲能建置，台塑新智能也協助統包建置AIDC，從備援電力、機房建置到後續營運，涉及高度整合的技術與服務能力，公司擁自主電芯、系統開發與工程整合經驗，再結合台塑企業長期累積的產業資源，具備切入AIDC市場的優勢，並持續推進美國的AIDC電池專案，預計明年進入北美市場。
此外，智慧場域也是擴大電池應用的重要方向，台塑新智能具備從整機設備需求開發電池系統的能力，從AGV、AMR到四足機器人不斷拓展應用，其中AGV電池已進入量產導入階段，累計取得超過600組訂單並陸續交付，另與多家自動化及製造業者展開驗證合作。
在四足機器人應用上，台塑新智能今日在展場也展示機器狗電池系統，是台塑新致能與中華汽車旗下全持股公司綠捷合作開發電池系統。
劉慧啟強調，繼公司去年與中華汽車合作開發國產電動車電池後，今年再度結合綠捷在智慧移動的專業上合作開發國產四足機器人(機器狗)的電池系統，目前尚在認證中，預計可在2027年第2季落地，鎖定大眾交通運輸點，如台鐵、捷運或是晶圓廠最全天候的巡檢等功能。
台塑新智能表示，公司未來亦深化大型儲能與前瞻技術布局，包括液冷儲能系統單櫃容量達4.61MWh，電芯溫差控制於3°C以內，提升運轉穩定性。
在固態電池推進上，以高面密度電極、乾法製程等關鍵技術，以及電池回收可提煉純度99.5%電池級碳酸鋰，目前中試線建置工程亦已啟動；微藻藻油取得ISCC EU驗證，朝永續航空燃油的原料規模化發展。
paras_en: Formosa Plastics' New Intelligence participated in Taiwan International Smart Energy Week this year (2026) under the theme “Global Energy, Driving the AI Future,” focusing on AI data center (AIDC) applications. The company showcased a high‑rate battery developed for AIDC backup needs, and the Changbin Phase‑II plant is planning to add 5 GWh of cells, with mass production expected in Q2 2028. General Manager Liu Hui‑chi said the firm is cooperating with China Motor Corp.’s subsidiary GreenTech to develop batteries for robot dogs, which are now being tested and are slated to receive certification and be deployed in 2027.

Formosa Plastics Group’s (1301‑TW) affiliated subsidiary Formosa Plastics New Intelligence has exhibited for three consecutive years. This year it centered on AIDC battery applications, using batteries as an entry point to expand into AI server room system integration, cloud service platforms (CSP) and operational management, demonstrating a business that spans energy equipment, engineering construction and operational services for AIDC.

Liu Hui‑chi explained that AI development requires computing power, which the government equates with national strength, but computing power cannot exist without electricity. Energy storage has become a strategic material, and amid the global wave of AIDC deployments, the company displayed a 90 V 50 Ah high‑rate battery capable of up to 8C continuous discharge. The battery is already integrated into the backup systems of a major semiconductor manufacturer’s AIDC in Taichung.

In coordination with the group’s memory‑chip giant Nanya Technology (2408‑TW), Formosa Plastics New Intelligence also provides turnkey AIDC solutions, covering backup power, data‑center construction and subsequent operations. Leveraging its own cell technology, system development and engineering integration experience, together with Formosa Plastics’ long‑standing industry resources, the company is well positioned to enter the AIDC market and is advancing an AIDC battery project in the United States, expected to enter the North American market next year.

Smart‑site applications are another key growth area for battery use. Formosa Plastics New Intelligence can develop battery systems from whole‑equipment requirements, expanding from AGVs and AMRs to quadruped robots. AGV batteries have entered mass‑production rollout, with over 600 orders secured and deliveries ongoing, and the company is collaborating with several automation and manufacturing firms on validation projects.
At the exhibition, the company also displayed a robot‑dog battery system, a joint development between Formosa Plastics New Intelligence and GreenTech, a wholly‑owned subsidiary of China Motor Corp.

Liu Hui‑chi emphasized that after last year’s collaboration with China Motor Corp. on domestic EV batteries, this year the partnership with GreenTech focuses on a domestically produced battery system for quadruped robots (robot dogs). The system is still undergoing certification and is expected to be deployed in Q2 2027, targeting public transport hubs such as Taiwan Railways, MRT stations, and round‑the‑clock inspection of wafer fabs.

Formosa Plastics New Intelligence said it will further deepen its large‑scale energy‑storage and forward‑looking technology portfolio, including liquid‑cooled storage units with a single‑cabinet capacity of 4.61 MWh and cell temperature differentials controlled within 3 °C to enhance operational stability.

In solid‑state battery development, the company is advancing key technologies such as high‑areal‑density electrodes and dry‑process manufacturing, and its battery‑recycling process can extract lithium carbonate of 99.5 % purity suitable for battery grade. A pilot line is under construction, and micro‑algae oil has obtained ISCC EU certification, moving toward scalable production of sustainable aviation fuel feedstock.

items.title: 台幣穩定幣「不穩」？董瑞斌坦言國銀發行意願低 傾向引進「這種」USDT
items.title_en: Is the Taiwan Dollar Stablecoin “Unstable”? Dong Ruibin Says National Banks Have Low Issuance Willingness, Prefer Introducing “This Kind” of USDT
paras: 金融資產質借規範與虛擬資產發展備受市場矚目，銀行公會理事長董瑞斌今（15）日於會員大會後受訪指出，針對高資產客戶的金融資產質借，將回歸各銀行的授信5P原則與風險控管，並嚴禁勸誘借錢投資。針對虛擬資產專法，董瑞斌坦言國銀發行新台幣穩定幣的意願極低，主要考量欠缺國際流通性、國內轉帳極度便利且維護區塊鏈成本過高，未來傾向直接引進摩根大通（JPMorgan）等國際大型金融機構發行的美元穩定幣，主攻B2B企業跨境支付商機。
針對近期金管會與中央銀行高度關注的金融資產質借規範與虛擬資產發展，董瑞斌表態指出，為防堵資金過度槓桿，金管會日前發文要求銀行公會針對金融資產質借研擬規範。公會已擬定作業指引，但公會版本不會明訂統一的擔保維持率與額度上限，將回歸各銀行落實授信5P原則與風險控管，內容待內部委員會簽核後，將直接提報金管會。
董瑞斌強調，針對高資產客戶拿股票、債券甚至是不動產作為擔保品，公會的指引不會訂出統一的擔保維持率或貸款倍數上限。他解釋，高資產客戶的財務狀況與還款來源與一般大眾不同，銀行應比照企業戶模式，根據客戶的整體信用狀況給予一個總額度，並透過財團法人金融聯合徵信中心系統跨行檢視。各銀行可依自身風險胃納決定授信寬緊，只要擔保品銀行願意接收即可，但絕對會嚴格落實禁止勸誘客戶借錢投資的鐵律。
在虛擬資產業務進度上，銀行公會已將穩定幣發行子法建議條文提報金管會，保管業務指引則尚在研擬中。雖然外界看好銀行挾準備金優勢成為穩定幣發行主力，但董瑞斌直言，新台幣穩定幣發展的意義不大，國銀發行意願極低。
董瑞斌點出三大現實考量，第一是新台幣穩定幣缺乏國際流通性，第二是國內傳統跨行轉帳管道已極度便利，欠缺實際應用場景，第三則是台灣的銀行在技術、人力與規模經濟上均有不足，自行建置與維護一條區塊鏈系統的成本過高，毫無規模經濟可言。

國銀真正想做的，是等摩根大通或花旗（Citi）等美國大行發行美元穩定幣後，由台灣的銀行與其對接並引進，提供給台灣的進出口廠商無限製兌換，概念如同數位的銀行旅行支票。董瑞斌分析，目前透過虛擬資產交易所的B2C模式，單筆進出額度過小，約在新台幣200萬元以內，根本無法滿足台積電 (2330-TW) (TSM-US)等大型出口商動輒數千萬美元的貿易結算需求。國銀的戰場在B2B，直接運用具國際公信力的美元穩定幣，才能創造實質商機。
針對近期市場關注的銀行流動性覆蓋比率（LCR）與資金緊俏議題，董瑞斌也從第一線實務提出觀察。他指出，近期央行國庫券與定存單（NCD）以及次級市場商業本票（CP2）利率全面上揚，顯示即使央行尚未調整政策利率，市場資金緊俏的現狀早已提前反映在利率上，如同美債殖利率在美國聯邦準備理事會決策前就會先行波動。面對資金變化，銀行端最直接的因應之道，就是積極吸收存款以穩固流動性。
此外，對於金管會主委彭金隆會中提及倡導「信任金融」、「全齡金融」、「金融韌性」、「金融回饋」等政策，董瑞斌表示，公會將積極推動金融回饋制度化與特色化。他強調，金融回饋不應只是各家銀行齊頭式地捐錢或降低利率，而是要做出特色。
董瑞斌身兼兆豐銀行董事長，他以兆豐銀為例，目前正大力推廣迷你棒球（Mini Baseball）運動，針對全台12歲以下推廣安全球具，全台約3000所小學，已捐贈超過1500所。他呼籲各銀行應將每年的金融回饋計畫提報至董事會報告或討論，將公益回饋視同推展業務般認真，讓公益活動走向長期化、系統化與制度化。
paras_en: Financial asset‑backed lending regulations and virtual‑asset development are drawing market attention. At the association’s members’ meeting today (the 15th), Dong Ruibin, chairman of the Bankers’ Association, said that for high‑net‑worth clients’ asset‑backed loans, banks will revert to the 5‑P credit principle and risk controls, and strictly prohibit urging customers to borrow for investment. Regarding the virtual‑asset special law, Dong admitted that national banks have almost no willingness to issue a New Taiwan Dollar stablecoin, mainly because of a lack of international liquidity, extremely convenient domestic transfers, and the high cost of maintaining a blockchain. In the future they prefer to import a US‑dollar stablecoin issued by large international institutions such as JPMorgan, targeting B2B cross‑border payment opportunities.

Regarding the recent focus by the Financial Supervisory Commission and the Central Bank on asset‑backed lending rules and virtual‑asset development, Dong said that to curb excessive leverage the FSC recently issued a directive asking the Bankers’ Association to draft regulations for asset‑backed loans. The association has prepared operational guidelines, but its version will not set a uniform collateral maintenance ratio or loan‑to‑value cap; instead it will return to each bank’s implementation of the 5‑P credit principle and risk controls. The content will be submitted to the FSC after internal committee approval.

Dong emphasized that for high‑net‑worth clients using stocks, bonds or even real estate as collateral, the association’s guidelines will not prescribe a uniform collateral maintenance ratio or loan‑multiple limit. He explained that such clients have financial situations and repayment sources different from the general public, so banks should treat them like corporate customers, granting an overall credit limit based on the client’s total credit profile and checking it across banks via the Financial Joint Credit Information Center system. Each bank can set its own credit tightness according to its risk appetite, as long as the collateral is acceptable, but the strict rule prohibiting urging customers to borrow for investment will be firmly enforced.

On the virtual‑asset side, the association has already submitted draft provisions for a stablecoin‑issuance sub‑law to the FSC, while custodial‑service guidelines are still under development. Although outsiders see banks’ reserve‑backed advantage as a potential driver for stablecoin issuance, Dong bluntly stated that a New Taiwan Dollar stablecoin has little significance and national banks have very low willingness to issue one.

Dong identified three practical concerns: first, a New Taiwan Dollar stablecoin lacks international circulation; second, domestic inter‑bank transfer channels are already extremely convenient, leaving few real‑world use cases; third, Taiwanese banks lack the technology, manpower and economies of scale, making the cost of building and maintaining a blockchain system prohibitively high with no scale benefits.

What national banks really want is to wait for major U.S. banks such as JPMorgan or Citi to launch a US‑dollar stablecoin, then connect Taiwanese banks to it and offer unlimited exchange to Taiwan’s import‑export firms – essentially a digital bank travel‑cheque. Dong analyzed that the current B2C model via virtual‑asset exchanges handles transaction sizes of only up to about NT$2 million, far too small to meet the trade‑settlement needs of large exporters like TSMC (2330‑TW) that may require tens of millions of dollars. The banks’ battlefield is B2B; using an internationally trusted US‑dollar stablecoin is the only way to create real business opportunities.

Addressing recent market concerns about banks’ liquidity coverage ratio (LCR) and tight funding, Dong shared frontline observations. He noted that yields on central‑bank treasury bills, negotiable certificates of deposit (NCDs) and secondary‑market commercial paper (CP2) have risen across the board, indicating that even though the central bank has not yet changed policy rates, the market’s funding tightness is already reflected in rates, similar to how U.S. Treasury yields move ahead of Federal Reserve decisions. In response, banks’ most direct action is to actively attract deposits to shore up liquidity.

Regarding Chairman Peng Jin‑long’s remarks at the FSC meeting about promoting “trust finance,” “all‑age finance,” “financial resilience,” and “financial feedback,” Dong said the association will actively push for institutionalized and differentiated financial feedback. He stressed that financial feedback should not be a uniform charity or rate cut by all banks, but should feature distinctive approaches.

Dong, who also serves as chairman of Mega International Commercial Bank, cited his own bank’s vigorous promotion of Mini Baseball for children under 12 nationwide, donating safe equipment to about 1 500 of roughly 3 000 elementary schools. He urged all banks to submit their annual financial‑feedback plans to their boards for discussion, treating charitable contributions with the same seriousness as business initiatives, so that public‑welfare activities become long‑term, systematic and institutionalized.

items.title: 各國指標鋼廠挺價+需求陸續釋出 中鴻11月內銷、12月外銷盤價順勢調漲
items.title_en: Key Steel Mills Abroad Hold Prices as Demand Gradually Emerges; Zhong Hong Raises Domestic November and Export December Prices
paras: 中鴻(2014-TW)今(14)日開出11月內銷及12月外銷盤價，當前鋼市供需結構持續調整，核心煉鋼原料對成本支撐仍強，且各國指標鋼廠挺價意願強烈，考量下游外貿接單及補庫需求陸續釋出，為反映鋼市現況並提振市場信心，盤價順勢調漲，內銷熱軋、冷軋、鍍鋅每公噸漲900元，外銷依產品及地區別調漲，實際報價視當地市場行情而定。
鋼鐵供需方面，中國鋼協（CISA）公布九月下旬數據顯示，重點鋼企日均粗鋼產量環比下降 2.1%、鋼材庫存量顯著下降 8.4%，顯示供給端調控與去庫進程順暢。此外，日本JFE Steel因先前極端天氣影響減產約60萬噸，加上韓國POSCO光陽廠高爐將於11月進行熄火大修，預計區域現貨供給將趨於收斂，支撐亞洲鋼市維持正向發展。
總體經濟方面，國際貨幣基金組織（IMF）最新《世界經濟展望》報告指出，受惠於 AI 相關投資需求帶動，全球經濟在中東局勢與貿易緊張下仍具韌性，預期2026年全球經濟成長上調至 3.1% ，並於2027年反彈至 3.4%。另，標普全球（S&P Global）九月全球製造業PMI升至53.0，創2022年二月以來新高，反映全球製造業景氣亦持續改善。
paras_en: Zhong Hong (2014‑TW) announced today (the 14th) its November domestic and December export price lists. With the steel market’s supply‑demand structure still adjusting, core steel‑making raw materials continue to support costs, and major steel mills in various countries are keen to hold prices. Considering that downstream foreign‑trade orders and inventory‑replenishment needs are being released, the company raised its listed prices to reflect current market conditions and boost confidence: domestic hot‑rolled, cold‑rolled and galvanized steel each increase by NT$900 per tonne, while export prices are adjusted by product and region, with actual quotations depending on local market conditions.

Regarding steel supply and demand, data released by the China Iron and Steel Association (CISA) for late September show that key Chinese steel producers’ daily crude steel output fell 2.1% month‑on‑month and steel inventories dropped sharply by 8.4%, indicating smooth supply‑side regulation and inventory reduction. In addition, Japan’s JFE Steel, hit by extreme weather, cut output by about 600,000 tonnes, and South Korea’s POSCO Guangyang plant will shut its blast furnace for major maintenance in November, so regional spot supply is expected to tighten, supporting a positive outlook for the Asian steel market.

On the macro‑economic front, the International Monetary Fund’s latest World Economic Outlook notes that, buoyed by AI‑related investment demand, the global economy remains resilient despite Middle‑East tensions and trade frictions, with 2026 global growth now projected at 3.1% and a rebound to 3.4% in 2027. Meanwhile, S&P Global reported that the September global manufacturing PMI rose to 53.0, the highest since February 2022, indicating continued improvement in worldwide manufacturing activity.

items.title: 施羅德首檔主動式ETF 00419A於11/2開募 10元甜甜價搶搭台股AI浪潮
items.title_en: Schroders Launches First Active ETF 00419A on Nov 2 at NT$10 to Ride Taiwan AI Wave
paras: 全球資產管理巨頭施羅德投信今（14）日宣布，正式將主動式ETF版圖延伸至台灣，推出深耕台灣近40年來的首檔主動式ETF「施羅德AI科技台股主動式ETF」 (00419A-TW) 。該基金預計於 11 月 2 日至 11 月 6 日進行募集，發行價格為新台幣 10 元，最低申購門檻僅需 1 萬元，並採季配息（預定 3/6/9/12 月）且導入收益平準金機制，滿足投資人追求資本利得與現金流的需求。
截至 2026 年 8 月底，施羅德在台管理資產規模已達新台幣 5,673 億元。施羅德投信董事長謝誠晃表示：「台灣不僅是全球科技產業重鎮，也是亞洲最活躍、發展最迅速的ETF市場之一。ETF架構兼具靈活性與高透明度，而主動式管理能讓我們適時因應市場變化、發掘潛在的新興贏家，建構高信心的投資組合。」
施羅德全球ETF主管 Tom Stephen 亦指出，台灣企業處於半導體創新與下一代科技發展的最前線，隨著AI應用加速滲透，產業鏈蘊含極大的投資潛力。本次結合施羅德全球橫跨 24 個地區、逾 650 位專業投資人的研究平台，將發揮深厚的台股選股實力。
針對投資人最關心的選股策略，施羅德台股團隊00419A基金經理人游信凱於記者會上直言，這一波AI浪潮與過去產業景氣循環不同，而是「產品規格升級帶來的選擇性成長週期」。隨著雲端服務商（CSP）資本支出持續激增，預估明年資本支出將突破 1.06 兆美元，AI 算力對於基礎建設的要求已不可同日而語。
游信凱進一步分析，當前單一晶片功耗大幅提升，一架AI伺服器機櫃的功耗動輒高達 125 千瓦（kW），「這相當於一棟大樓的用電量在持續運轉！」因此，龐大的發熱與耗電需求，將帶動電源供應、散熱模組（如液冷技術）、電力基礎建設與重電族群的強勁規格升級需求。
00419A 將從超過 300 檔AI相關企業中，精選出 30 檔以上的優質個股，三大核心佈局方向包含：
關鍵零組件與半導體：包含先進製程、先進封裝（CoWoS）、IC設計與高速傳輸。
基礎建設與電力散熱：涵蓋散熱模組、重電設備與不斷電系統等算力支援供應鏈。
新型AI應用與軟硬整合：延伸至邊緣AI、機器人開發及新軟體應用等未來十年的潛力領域。
面對市場關注主動式ETF如何擊敗大盤，施羅德團隊強調，台股科技產業並非所有公司都能吃到訂單，唯有能夠滿足科技大廠嚴格規格要求的企業才能脫穎而出。團隊每天透過嚴謹的基本面分析與評判，尋找具備產品升級能力與獲利上修潛力的個股。
游信凱指出：「我們追求的是長期績效表現與高信念的投資佈局，而非短線跟風。透過團隊合作與徹底的基本面功課，協助投資人不僅能喝到AI浪潮的『肉湯』，更能精準抓到最核心的獲利主軸。」
施羅德AI科技台股主動式ETF (00419A) 將於 11 月 2 日正式募集，風險報酬等級為 RR5，提供投資人以小額資金靈活卡位全球AI供應鏈核心的絕佳工具。
paras_en: Global asset manager Schroders Investment Trust announced today (the 14th) that it is formally extending its active‑ETF footprint to Taiwan with the launch of its first active ETF focused on Taiwan, the Schroders AI Technology Taiwan Stock Active ETF (00419A‑TW). The fund is slated to raise capital from November 2 to November 6, with an issue price of NT$10 per unit, a minimum subscription of NT$10,000, quarterly distributions (scheduled for March, June, September and December) and a yield‑smoothing mechanism to meet investors’ desires for both capital gains and cash flow.

As of the end of August 2026, Schroders’ assets under management in Taiwan total NT$567.3 billion. Schroders Investment Trust Chairman Hsieh Cheng‑Huang said, “Taiwan is not only a global technology hub but also one of the most active and fastest‑growing ETF markets in Asia. The ETF structure offers flexibility and high transparency, while active management lets us respond to market changes and uncover emerging winners, building a high‑conviction portfolio.”

Schroders Global ETF head Tom Stephen also noted that Taiwanese companies sit at the forefront of semiconductor innovation and next‑generation technology development. With AI applications accelerating, the supply chain holds huge investment potential. This launch leverages Schroders’ global research platform spanning 24 regions and more than 650 professional investors to apply deep Taiwan‑stock stock‑picking expertise.

Addressing investors’ top concern—stock‑selection strategy—Schroders Taiwan‑stock team manager Yu Hsin‑Kai said at the press conference that this AI wave differs from past industry cycles, representing a “selective growth cycle driven by product‑spec upgrades.” With cloud‑service providers’ capital expenditures surging, next year’s capex is projected to exceed $1.06 trillion, and AI compute power demands on infrastructure are now incomparable to the past.

Yu further explained that today a single AI chip’s power consumption has risen sharply; an AI server rack can draw as much as 125 kW, “equivalent to the electricity usage of an entire building running continuously!” This massive heat and power demand will drive strong upgrades in power‑supply units, cooling modules (such as liquid‑cooling technology), power‑grid infrastructure and heavy‑electric equipment sectors.
The 00419A fund will select more than 30 high‑quality stocks from over 300 AI‑related companies, focusing on three core thematic pillars:
Key components and semiconductors, including advanced processes, advanced packaging (CoWoS), IC design and high‑speed interconnects.
Infrastructure and power‑thermal solutions, covering cooling modules, heavy‑electric equipment and uninterruptible power systems that support compute power supply chains.
New AI applications and hardware‑software integration, extending to edge AI, robotics development and emerging software uses that represent potential growth areas over the next decade.

When asked how an active ETF can outperform the broader market, the Schroders team emphasized that not every Taiwan tech firm will capture orders; only those that meet the stringent specifications of major tech manufacturers can stand out. The team conducts rigorous daily fundamental analysis to identify companies with product‑upgrade capabilities and upside earnings‑revision potential.

Yu Hsin‑Kai added, “We aim for long‑term performance and high‑conviction positioning, not short‑term hype. Through teamwork and thorough fundamental research, we help investors not only sip the ‘broth’ of the AI wave but also pinpoint the core profit drivers with precision.”

The Schroders AI Technology Taiwan Stock Active ETF (00419A) will officially commence fundraising on November 2, carries a risk‑return rating of RR5, and offers investors a low‑cost, flexible way to gain exposure to the core of the global AI supply chain.

items.title: 沒花公帑就堆出銅山！川普關稅威脅奏效 如今囤銅潮降溫
paras: 川普關稅威脅讓美國「銅堆成山」，如今吸力正逐漸減弱。市場擔憂美國對進口精煉銅課稅，促使交易商提前運銅赴美，讓美國未動用公帑便累積逾百萬公噸庫存。然而，隨著美國與海外銅價差縮小，加上關稅決策遲未出爐，這波囤銅潮正在降溫。
目前，紐約商品交易所(Comex)認可的美國倉庫持有全球約七成可見銅庫存。金屬集中流向美國，造成其他地區供應吃緊，即使全球整體供過於求，仍推升銅價。關稅是否實施、何時上路，以及能否持續吸引銅流入，將成為10月18日起倫敦金屬交易所(LME)年會的重要議題。

美國溢價大幅縮水 運銅套利誘因減弱

川普去年2月下令研究銅關稅後，交易商便持續將銅運往美國。Comex銅價今年9月22日升至每磅6.83美元、相當於每公噸15,057美元的歷史高點。
美國銅價高於LME價格，扣除運費、保險等成本後，仍可帶來套利收益。這項價差去年7月一度突破每公噸3,000美元，如今僅約310美元，運銅赴美已不再一直有利可圖。
Wood Mackenzie分析師Charles Cooper指出，美國靠政策與進口關稅威脅，在未花納稅人金錢的情況下建立庫存，但套利空間大幅收窄，繼續運入金屬的誘因已明顯減弱。
Panmure Liberum分析師Tom Price則批評，獲利的只有交易商；若從交易所外市場低調收購，美國原本可用更低成本取得銅。

關稅決策仍懸而未決 美國庫存遠超需求

美國商務部原定今年6月30日前提交國內銅市場報告，供川普決定是否自2027年元旦對進口精煉銅課徵15%關稅，並於2028年提高至30%，但至今尚未公布決定。
麥格理分析師Alice Fox認為，最可能的情況是明年1月期限過後仍無定論。套利價差可能先縮小，再回到目前水準，雖不足以吸引更多銅流入，卻足以讓既有庫存留在美國。
麥格理估計，美國交易所內外銅庫存合計約160萬公噸。Comex庫存自去年2月底以來激增近750%，超過71.4萬公噸；LME位於紐奧良及巴爾的摩的倉庫，自8月中以來也增加44%，接近13萬公噸。
Price估計，美國今年銅需求約160萬公噸。去年進口量已逾162萬公噸，較2024年增加80%，另有約100萬公噸國內產量，分析師預期今年仍將供過於求。
這些過剩金屬若要出口，LME與上海期貨交易所銅價須明顯高於Comex，而這可能得等到美國以外地區嚴重缺銅才會發生。

items.title: 輝達再度出資台廠：預付京元電美國測試產能和認購聯發科ECB有何不同？
items.title_en: Nvidia Invests Again in Taiwanese Firms: How Does Its Prepayment to ASE Technology’s US Test Capacity Differ from Its Subscription to MediaTek’s ECB?
paras: 輝達 (NVDA) 繼8月底認購聯發科 (2454-TW) 海外可轉換公司債後，10月13日再與京元電 (2449-TW) 簽訂客戶預付款協議，接連以資金支持台灣半導體供應鏈。
不過，兩案雖同樣獲輝達資金挹注，合作目的及成長想像並不相同；前者是策略投資，後者則是預付測試服務費、提前鎖定產能。

對聯發科：認購可轉債合作充滿想像
聯發科8月31日宣布發行總額39億美元的海外可轉換公司債（ECB），輝達認購其中35億美元，債券票面利率為零，持有人未來得依約轉換為聯發科股票。
這筆交易使輝達取得債權及潛在股權，而非立即成為股東；對聯發科而言，則是在可轉債架構下取得長期資金，支持研發與業務擴展。
更關鍵的是，雙方同步宣布擴大AI基礎建設、終端AI運算及車用平台合作。聯發科在既有NVLink Fusion合作基礎上，進一步深化ASIC與機櫃級AI系統整合，降低CSP導入客製化XPU的門檻，不必完全從零打造Scale-up互連、記憶體架構及機櫃整合系統，這讓聯發科有機會爭取更多設計與系統整合商機。

對京元電：預付貨款確保後段產能供給
京元電則由公司及旗下美國子公司AeternZ與輝達簽署客戶預付款協議，由輝達先付款，京元電在美建置並預留測試產能，後續提供服務再逐步抵減。這筆資金並非股權投資，也不是收款當下即可認列的營收，其作用在於支撐美國廠初期投資、減輕資金壓力及提高產能需求能見度。
值得注意的是，京元電在9月17日曾因應美國子公司與客戶簽訂產能建置及保留合約需求，核准提供最高3億美元的連帶保證，顯示客戶原先要求台灣母公司為美國新廠履約提供保障。
不過京元電10月13日同步宣布取消該背書保證，改為共同輝達簽訂預付款協議的方式。
此次調整不僅確認輝達為美國測試產能的重要合作客戶，也讓雙方資金支持與產能保留的商業模式更加明確，但對於市場沒有進一步的驚喜：
京元電與輝達的合作早已深入核心測試業務。京元電8月底法說會指出，2025年上半年由GPU客戶率先帶動擴產，下半年再加入ASIC需求，且客戶集中度持續提高。2025年財報更顯示，最大單一客戶營收貢獻達126.5億元、占比36%，較前一年的18%倍增。
（圖片來源：優分析產業數據中心）
雖然公司未揭露該客戶身分，但結合輝達官方已將京元電列入Vera Rubin供應鏈，以及法人對Rubin GPU、Vera CPU測試訂單的分析，市場高度推測輝達已躍居京元電第一大客戶，更有法人預估輝達已佔京元電營收50%以上。
除了雙方合作早已在市場預期內，該預付協議條款亦未公開，因此無法確認實際風險分攤及訂單保障程度。
京元電2026全年資本支出於4月上調至500億元；而美國投資額上限為14億美元，於7月正式核准，規劃2028年小量運轉。
不過，隨AI晶片封裝與功耗提高，法人預期測試時間、預燒及散熱需求將同步提升，京元電的高功耗測試能力可望轉化為更高的單顆晶片測試價值。輝達選擇以預付款預留產能，也凸顯後段測試在供應鏈中的關鍵地位。
因此，兩案利多的時間與性質有別。聯發科最具想像的是藉輝達生態系開拓新客戶、新產品，ASIC業務成長有望擴大；
相較之下，京元電原本就是輝達重要GPU測試夥伴，美國設廠與客戶產能保留規劃也早已揭露。此次預付款協議的突破，主要在於確認輝達願意提供資金支持，降低海外建廠的資金壓力並確保己方需求無虞，但沒有進一步的數字與份額可以觀察。
京元電尚未揭露預付款金額、最低採購量及美國廠獲利條件，14億美元也只是投資額上限，不等同輝達資金承諾。能否進一步推升獲利，仍須觀察新廠稼動率、測試單價與成本結構，在後續產能爬坡時對於整體營利的影響。

paras_en: Nvidia (NVDA) followed its late‑August subscription to MediaTek (2454‑TW) overseas convertible bonds with a customer pre‑payment agreement with ASE Technology (2449‑TW) on October 13, continuing to fund Taiwan’s semiconductor supply chain with cash.

However, although both deals receive Nvidia funding, their purposes and growth narratives differ; the former is a strategic investment, while the latter is a pre‑payment for test services and an advance reservation of capacity.

For MediaTek: the convertible bond subscription is full of imagination. MediaTek announced on August 31 the issuance of $3.9 billion of overseas convertible bonds (ECB), of which Nvidia subscribed $3.5 billion. The bonds carry a zero coupon rate and holders can later convert them into MediaTek shares under the agreed terms.

This transaction gives Nvidia a debt claim and potential equity, not immediate shareholder status; for MediaTek, it secures long‑term financing under the ECB structure to support R&D and business expansion.

More importantly, both sides simultaneously announced an expansion of AI infrastructure, edge AI computing and automotive platform cooperation. Building on the existing NVLink Fusion partnership, MediaTek will deepen ASIC and rack‑level AI system integration, lowering the CSP’s barrier to adopt custom XPU without having to build scale‑up interconnects, memory architecture and rack integration from scratch, giving MediaTek a chance to win more design and system‑integration opportunities.

For ASE Technology: the pre‑payment secures downstream capacity supply. ASE and its U.S. subsidiary AeternZ signed a customer pre‑payment agreement with Nvidia, whereby Nvidia pays up front and ASE reserves test capacity in the United States, recouping the amount gradually as services are delivered. This is not an equity investment nor revenue that can be recognized immediately; it is intended to support early U.S. plant investment, ease cash‑flow pressure and improve visibility of capacity demand.

It is worth noting that on September 17 ASE approved a joint guarantee of up to $300 million to meet a capacity‑building and reservation contract required by its U.S. subsidiary’s customer, indicating the customer originally asked the Taiwanese parent to back the new U.S. plant’s performance.
However, on October 13 ASE announced the cancellation of that guarantee, replacing it with the joint pre‑payment agreement with Nvidia.

The adjustment not only confirms Nvidia as a key customer for U.S. test capacity, but also clarifies the commercial model of cash support and capacity reservation, though it does not bring any further surprise to the market:

ASE’s cooperation with Nvidia has long been deep in core testing services. At its late‑August earnings briefing, ASE said that in the first half of 2025 GPU customers will drive capacity expansion, with ASIC demand added in the second half, and that customer concentration will continue to rise. The 2025 financials later showed the top single customer contributed NT$12.65 billion, or 36% of revenue, more than double the 18% share a year earlier.
(Image source: You Analysis Industry Data Center)

Although the company did not disclose the customer’s identity, Nvidia’s official listing of ASE in the Vera Rubin supply chain and analysts’ reviews of Rubin GPU and Vera CPU test orders lead the market to strongly infer that Nvidia has become ASE’s largest customer, with some analysts estimating Nvidia now accounts for over 50% of ASE’s revenue.
Beyond the market’s expectation of the partnership, the terms of the pre‑payment agreement have not been made public, so the actual risk‑sharing and order‑guarantee levels cannot be verified.
ASE raised its 2026 full‑year capital expenditure in April to NT$50 billion; the U.S. investment cap is $1.4 billion, approved in July and slated for modest operation in 2028.

Nevertheless, as AI chip packaging and power consumption rise, analysts expect testing time, burn‑in and cooling needs to increase in tandem, and ASE’s high‑power testing capability could translate into higher per‑chip test value. Nvidia’s choice to pre‑pay for reserved capacity also highlights the critical role of downstream testing in the supply chain.
Thus, the two deals differ in timing and nature. MediaTek’s story is most imaginative, leveraging Nvidia’s ecosystem to open new customers and products, with ASIC business growth expected to expand;

In contrast, ASE has already been a key Nvidia GPU testing partner, and its U.S. plant and capacity‑reservation plans have long been disclosed. The breakthrough of this pre‑payment agreement lies mainly in confirming Nvidia’s willingness to provide cash support, easing the financing burden of overseas plant construction and securing its own demand, though no further figures or share allocations are disclosed.

ASE has not revealed the pre‑payment amount, minimum purchase volume or profit terms for the U.S. plant; the $1.4 billion figure is merely the investment cap and does not equal Nvidia’s cash commitment. Whether it can boost profitability will depend on the new plant’s utilization, test pricing and cost structure, and its impact on overall earnings as capacity ramps up.

items.title: 金管會攜銀行公會創新金融！彭金隆提3大期許 加速穩定幣與虛擬資產整合
items.title_en: Financial Supervisory Commission Teams Up with Bankers Association for Innovative Finance! Peng Jin‑long Sets Three Major Expectations to Accelerate Stablecoin and Virtual Asset Integration
paras: 銀行公會第15屆第2次會員代表大會於今（14）日登場，由銀行公會理事長董瑞斌主持，金管會主委彭金隆特別蒞臨致詞。彭金隆在會中高度肯定銀行公會扮演政府與產業溝通橋樑，並對金融業提出三大期許，強調今年前8個月整體銀行業獲利優異，但面對全球經濟不確定性，銀行業應在晴天時廣積糧，持續強化資本強韌度，同時推動信任金融與全齡金融，並落實外部引進與內部培育的雙軌人才戰略，以迎接台灣金融產業高度成長的需要。
彭金隆致詞時首先表達感謝，指出面對國內外經濟劇烈變動與新興科技帶來的挑戰，銀行公會長期全力支持金管會推動各項政策，特別是在協助亞洲資產管理中心專區的私人銀行、家族辦公室及OBU財富管理業務三大工作坊運作上成果顯著，順利推動家族辦公室在台灣落地，為後續法規調適與業務全面推廣打下堅實基礎。
在防詐政策與實體經濟支持方面，彭金隆表示，感謝銀行第一線同仁在阻詐防詐上的無私付出，銀行管理層應給予第一線從業人員最大的支持與鼓勵。此外，目前金融機構對中小企業的放款目標已提前順利達標，期許各銀行未來持續積極協助中小企業發展。針對金融科技與數位轉型，他感謝公會協助研擬穩定幣發行及管理授權子法的建議條文，協助建立穩定幣與虛擬資產的基本監理架構，期待未來能進一步整合傳統金融與區塊鏈金融。
面對金融業未來發展，彭金隆對整體銀行業提出三大明確期許。首先是強化資本結構與資本強韌度，彭金隆指出，今年前8個月整體銀行獲利表現超越前兩年，但在榮景之下更要提高風險意識，銀行業者必須在晴天時廣積糧，持續增強資本結構，唯有資本足夠強大，才能從容因應未來經濟高度成長與潛在市場波動的需要。
其次是推動信任金融、金融大回饋及全齡金融，彭金隆認為銀行擁有良好的經營績效後，應當積極回饋社會、深化社會信任，未來主管機關在金融政策上將有更大幅度的開放，並會持續檢討現行金融服務範圍，儘可能滿足不同族群的需求，尋找新的發展契機。
最後則是全力培養與吸引人才，彭金隆強調，銀行業務的成長完全取決於人才，市場成長必須人才先行，銀行應採用外部引進與內部培育並重的雙軌策略，除了深化本土培育，更要積極吸引國外優秀金融人才，藉此全面提升台灣金融業的國際競爭力。
董瑞斌回應表示，隨著國際經濟與金融情勢快速變化，銀行業面臨的挑戰日趨嚴峻。為配合政策推動台灣成為亞洲資產管理中心，公會已持續研議各項配套措施，修正銀行高資產客戶財富管理業務實務參考文件，並舉辦產業論壇，朝打造具台灣特色的資產管理中心邁進。因應人工智慧與新興科技發展，公會已修訂金融機構運用人工智慧技術作業規範，研提穩定幣授權子法可行建議，並完成量子科技對台灣金融業影響的研究報告。
針對金融安全與防詐，公會協助研擬ATM存入控管措施、修正疑似洗錢交易態樣，並配合研修詐欺犯罪危害防制條例相關子法，透過金檢警跨業聯防與臨櫃關懷，全力守護民眾財產安全。在誠信文化方面，也已研訂銀行業行為與文化管理指引，確保產業穩健經營。
paras_en: The 15th term, 2nd meeting of the Bankers Association’s member representatives was held today (the 14th), chaired by Association chairman Dong Ruibin, with Financial Supervisory Commission (FSC) Chairperson Peng Jin‑long delivering a special address. Peng praised the Association’s role as a bridge between government and industry, and laid out three key expectations for the financial sector, noting that banks posted strong profits in the first eight months of the year but must, amid global economic uncertainty, build reserves in good times, keep strengthening capital resilience, promote trustworthy and all‑age finance, and implement a dual‑track talent strategy of external recruitment and internal development to meet Taiwan’s rapid financial‑industry growth needs.

Peng began his remarks by thanking the Association, pointing out that amid volatile domestic and overseas economies and challenges from emerging technologies, the Bankers Association has consistently supported the FSC’s policy initiatives. He highlighted the Association’s notable contributions to the Asian Asset Management Center’s private‑banking, family‑office and OBU wealth‑management workshops, which have successfully anchored family offices in Taiwan and laid a solid foundation for subsequent regulatory adjustments and broader business rollout.

Regarding anti‑fraud measures and support for the real economy, Peng expressed gratitude for frontline bank staff’s selfless efforts in fraud prevention and urged bank management to give them maximum support and encouragement. He noted that financial institutions have already met their loan‑disbursement targets for SMEs ahead of schedule and called on banks to continue actively assisting SME development. On fintech and digital transformation, he thanked the Association for helping draft the stablecoin issuance and management authorization sub‑law provisions, which establish a basic supervisory framework for stablecoins and virtual assets, and he looks forward to deeper integration of traditional finance with blockchain finance.

Looking ahead, Peng set three clear expectations for the banking sector. First, to strengthen capital structure and resilience. He observed that while banks’ profit performance in the first eight months surpassed that of the previous two years, the sector must heighten risk awareness, stockpile reserves in good times, and continuously enhance capital adequacy so it can comfortably handle future high‑growth economies and market volatility.

Second, to promote trustworthy finance, major financial give‑backs and all‑age finance. Peng argued that once banks achieve solid performance, they should give back to society and deepen public trust. He said regulators will further open up financial policies and continuously review the scope of financial services to meet the needs of diverse groups and seek new development opportunities.

Third, to fully cultivate and attract talent. Peng emphasized that the growth of banking services depends entirely on talent; market expansion must be talent‑driven. Banks should adopt a dual‑track strategy of external recruitment and internal development, deepening local talent pipelines while actively attracting outstanding overseas financial professionals to boost Taiwan’s international competitiveness.

Dong Ruibin responded that rapid changes in the global economy and financial landscape are intensifying challenges for banks. To align with policies positioning Taiwan as an Asian asset‑management hub, the Association has been formulating supporting measures, revising practical reference documents for wealth‑management services to high‑net‑worth clients, and hosting industry forums to build a Taiwan‑characteristic asset‑management centre. In response to AI and emerging technologies, the Association has updated guidelines for AI use by financial institutions, proposed feasible stablecoin authorization sub‑law recommendations, and completed a research report on the impact of quantum technology on Taiwan’s financial sector.

Regarding financial security and fraud prevention, the Association helped draft ATM deposit control measures, revised suspicious money‑laundering transaction patterns, and collaborated on sub‑law development for the Fraud Crime Prevention Act. Through cross‑industry cooperation among the FSC, police and banks and on‑site customer care, it aims to protect the public’s assets. In terms of integrity culture, it has also formulated behavioral and cultural management guidelines for banks to ensure the industry’s sound operation.

items.title: 〈智慧能源週〉台塑新智能攜手綠捷跨足機器狗電池開發 彰濱二期廠力拚2028年Q2量產
items.title_en: Smart Energy Week: Formosa Plastics' New Intelligence Partners with GreenTech to Develop Robot Dog Batteries, Changbin Phase‑II Aims for Q2 2028 Mass Production
paras: 台塑新智能今 (2026) 年以「全域能源，驅動AI未來」為主題參加台灣國際智慧能源周，聚焦AI資料中心(AIDC)應用，此次展出高倍率電池即針對AIDC備援需求開發，彰濱二期正規劃新增5GWh(百萬瓩時)電芯，估逾2028年第2季量產。台塑新智能總經理劉慧啟表示，公司與中華汽車(2204-TW)子綠捷合作開發機器狗專用電池，正進行測試，預計明(2027)年通過認證落地。
台塑(1301-TW)集團轉投資子公司台塑新智能已連續3年參展，今年聚焦AIDC電池應用，從電池切入，進一步拓展至AI伺服器機房系統整合及CSP(雲端服務)與營運管理，展現橫跨能源設備、工程建置與營運服務的AIDC事業。
劉惠啟說，發展AI一定需要算力，連政府都倡導算力即國力，但沒有電力就沒有算力，加上儲能已成為關鍵戰略物資，面對全球AIDC的建置潮，此次展出90V50Ah高倍率電池，最高可支援8C連續放電，目前已導入台中的半導體大廠中的AIDC備援系統。
同時，配合集團公司記憶體大廠南亞科(2408-TW)的儲能建置，台塑新智能也協助統包建置AIDC，從備援電力、機房建置到後續營運，涉及高度整合的技術與服務能力，公司擁自主電芯、系統開發與工程整合經驗，再結合台塑企業長期累積的產業資源，具備切入AIDC市場的優勢，並持續推進美國的AIDC電池專案，預計明年進入北美市場。
此外，智慧場域也是擴大電池應用的重要方向，台塑新智能具備從整機設備需求開發電池系統的能力，從AGV、AMR到四足機器人不斷拓展應用，其中AGV電池已進入量產導入階段，累計取得超過600組訂單並陸續交付，另與多家自動化及製造業者展開驗證合作。
在四足機器人應用上，台塑新智能今日在展場也展示機器狗電池系統，是台塑新致能與中華汽車旗下全持股公司綠捷合作開發電池系統。
劉慧啟強調，繼公司去年與中華汽車合作開發國產電動車電池後，今年再度結合綠捷在智慧移動的專業上合作開發國產四足機器人(機器狗)的電池系統，目前尚在認證中，預計可在2027年第2季落地，鎖定大眾交通運輸點，如台鐵、捷運或是晶圓廠最全天候的巡檢等功能。
台塑新智能表示，公司未來亦深化大型儲能與前瞻技術布局，包括液冷儲能系統單櫃容量達4.61MWh，電芯溫差控制於3°C以內，提升運轉穩定性。
在固態電池推進上，以高面密度電極、乾法製程等關鍵技術，以及電池回收可提煉純度99.5%電池級碳酸鋰，目前中試線建置工程亦已啟動；微藻藻油取得ISCC EU驗證，朝永續航空燃油的原料規模化發展。
paras_en: Formosa Plastics' New Intelligence participated in Taiwan International Smart Energy Week this year (2026) under the theme “Global Energy, Driving the AI Future,” focusing on AI data center (AIDC) applications. The company showcased a high‑rate battery developed for AIDC backup needs, and the Changbin Phase‑II plant is planning to add 5 GWh of cells, with mass production expected in Q2 2028. General Manager Liu Hui‑chi said the firm is cooperating with China Motor Corp.’s subsidiary GreenTech to develop batteries for robot dogs, which are now being tested and are slated to receive certification and be deployed in 2027.

Formosa Plastics Group’s (1301‑TW) affiliated subsidiary Formosa Plastics New Intelligence has exhibited for three consecutive years. This year it centered on AIDC battery applications, using batteries as an entry point to expand into AI server room system integration, cloud service platforms (CSP) and operational management, demonstrating a business that spans energy equipment, engineering construction and operational services for AIDC.

Liu Hui‑chi explained that AI development requires computing power, which the government equates with national strength, but computing power cannot exist without electricity. Energy storage has become a strategic material, and amid the global wave of AIDC deployments, the company displayed a 90 V 50 Ah high‑rate battery capable of up to 8C continuous discharge. The battery is already integrated into the backup systems of a major semiconductor manufacturer’s AIDC in Taichung.

In coordination with the group’s memory‑chip giant Nanya Technology (2408‑TW), Formosa Plastics New Intelligence also provides turnkey AIDC solutions, covering backup power, data‑center construction and subsequent operations. Leveraging its own cell technology, system development and engineering integration experience, together with Formosa Plastics’ long‑standing industry resources, the company is well positioned to enter the AIDC market and is advancing an AIDC battery project in the United States, expected to enter the North American market next year.

Smart‑site applications are another key growth area for battery use. Formosa Plastics New Intelligence can develop battery systems from whole‑equipment requirements, expanding from AGVs and AMRs to quadruped robots. AGV batteries have entered mass‑production rollout, with over 600 orders secured and deliveries ongoing, and the company is collaborating with several automation and manufacturing firms on validation projects.
At the exhibition, the company also displayed a robot‑dog battery system, a joint development between Formosa Plastics New Intelligence and GreenTech, a wholly‑owned subsidiary of China Motor Corp.

Liu Hui‑chi emphasized that after last year’s collaboration with China Motor Corp. on domestic EV batteries, this year the partnership with GreenTech focuses on a domestically produced battery system for quadruped robots (robot dogs). The system is still undergoing certification and is expected to be deployed in Q2 2027, targeting public transport hubs such as Taiwan Railways, MRT stations, and round‑the‑clock inspection of wafer fabs.

Formosa Plastics New Intelligence said it will further deepen its large‑scale energy‑storage and forward‑looking technology portfolio, including liquid‑cooled storage units with a single‑cabinet capacity of 4.61 MWh and cell temperature differentials controlled within 3 °C to enhance operational stability.

In solid‑state battery development, the company is advancing key technologies such as high‑areal‑density electrodes and dry‑process manufacturing, and its battery‑recycling process can extract lithium carbonate of 99.5 % purity suitable for battery grade. A pilot line is under construction, and micro‑algae oil has obtained ISCC EU certification, moving toward scalable production of sustainable aviation fuel feedstock.

items.title: 台幣穩定幣「不穩」？董瑞斌坦言國銀發行意願低 傾向引進「這種」USDT
items.title_en: Is the Taiwan Dollar Stablecoin “Unstable”? Dong Ruibin Says National Banks Have Low Issuance Willingness, Prefer Introducing “This Kind” of USDT
paras: 金融資產質借規範與虛擬資產發展備受市場矚目，銀行公會理事長董瑞斌今（15）日於會員大會後受訪指出，針對高資產客戶的金融資產質借，將回歸各銀行的授信5P原則與風險控管，並嚴禁勸誘借錢投資。針對虛擬資產專法，董瑞斌坦言國銀發行新台幣穩定幣的意願極低，主要考量欠缺國際流通性、國內轉帳極度便利且維護區塊鏈成本過高，未來傾向直接引進摩根大通（JPMorgan）等國際大型金融機構發行的美元穩定幣，主攻B2B企業跨境支付商機。
針對近期金管會與中央銀行高度關注的金融資產質借規範與虛擬資產發展，董瑞斌表態指出，為防堵資金過度槓桿，金管會日前發文要求銀行公會針對金融資產質借研擬規範。公會已擬定作業指引，但公會版本不會明訂統一的擔保維持率與額度上限，將回歸各銀行落實授信5P原則與風險控管，內容待內部委員會簽核後，將直接提報金管會。
董瑞斌強調，針對高資產客戶拿股票、債券甚至是不動產作為擔保品，公會的指引不會訂出統一的擔保維持率或貸款倍數上限。他解釋，高資產客戶的財務狀況與還款來源與一般大眾不同，銀行應比照企業戶模式，根據客戶的整體信用狀況給予一個總額度，並透過財團法人金融聯合徵信中心系統跨行檢視。各銀行可依自身風險胃納決定授信寬緊，只要擔保品銀行願意接收即可，但絕對會嚴格落實禁止勸誘客戶借錢投資的鐵律。
在虛擬資產業務進度上，銀行公會已將穩定幣發行子法建議條文提報金管會，保管業務指引則尚在研擬中。雖然外界看好銀行挾準備金優勢成為穩定幣發行主力，但董瑞斌直言，新台幣穩定幣發展的意義不大，國銀發行意願極低。
董瑞斌點出三大現實考量，第一是新台幣穩定幣缺乏國際流通性，第二是國內傳統跨行轉帳管道已極度便利，欠缺實際應用場景，第三則是台灣的銀行在技術、人力與規模經濟上均有不足，自行建置與維護一條區塊鏈系統的成本過高，毫無規模經濟可言。

國銀真正想做的，是等摩根大通或花旗（Citi）等美國大行發行美元穩定幣後，由台灣的銀行與其對接並引進，提供給台灣的進出口廠商無限製兌換，概念如同數位的銀行旅行支票。董瑞斌分析，目前透過虛擬資產交易所的B2C模式，單筆進出額度過小，約在新台幣200萬元以內，根本無法滿足台積電 (2330-TW) (TSM-US)等大型出口商動輒數千萬美元的貿易結算需求。國銀的戰場在B2B，直接運用具國際公信力的美元穩定幣，才能創造實質商機。
針對近期市場關注的銀行流動性覆蓋比率（LCR）與資金緊俏議題，董瑞斌也從第一線實務提出觀察。他指出，近期央行國庫券與定存單（NCD）以及次級市場商業本票（CP2）利率全面上揚，顯示即使央行尚未調整政策利率，市場資金緊俏的現狀早已提前反映在利率上，如同美債殖利率在美國聯邦準備理事會決策前就會先行波動。面對資金變化，銀行端最直接的因應之道，就是積極吸收存款以穩固流動性。
此外，對於金管會主委彭金隆會中提及倡導「信任金融」、「全齡金融」、「金融韌性」、「金融回饋」等政策，董瑞斌表示，公會將積極推動金融回饋制度化與特色化。他強調，金融回饋不應只是各家銀行齊頭式地捐錢或降低利率，而是要做出特色。
董瑞斌身兼兆豐銀行董事長，他以兆豐銀為例，目前正大力推廣迷你棒球（Mini Baseball）運動，針對全台12歲以下推廣安全球具，全台約3000所小學，已捐贈超過1500所。他呼籲各銀行應將每年的金融回饋計畫提報至董事會報告或討論，將公益回饋視同推展業務般認真，讓公益活動走向長期化、系統化與制度化。
paras_en: Financial asset‑backed lending regulations and virtual‑asset development are drawing market attention. At the association’s members’ meeting today (the 15th), Dong Ruibin, chairman of the Bankers’ Association, said that for high‑net‑worth clients’ asset‑backed loans, banks will revert to the 5‑P credit principle and risk controls, and strictly prohibit urging customers to borrow for investment. Regarding the virtual‑asset special law, Dong admitted that national banks have almost no willingness to issue a New Taiwan Dollar stablecoin, mainly because of a lack of international liquidity, extremely convenient domestic transfers, and the high cost of maintaining a blockchain. In the future they prefer to import a US‑dollar stablecoin issued by large international institutions such as JPMorgan, targeting B2B cross‑border payment opportunities.

Regarding the recent focus by the Financial Supervisory Commission and the Central Bank on asset‑backed lending rules and virtual‑asset development, Dong said that to curb excessive leverage the FSC recently issued a directive asking the Bankers’ Association to draft regulations for asset‑backed loans. The association has prepared operational guidelines, but its version will not set a uniform collateral maintenance ratio or loan‑to‑value cap; instead it will return to each bank’s implementation of the 5‑P credit principle and risk controls. The content will be submitted to the FSC after internal committee approval.

Dong emphasized that for high‑net‑worth clients using stocks, bonds or even real estate as collateral, the association’s guidelines will not prescribe a uniform collateral maintenance ratio or loan‑multiple limit. He explained that such clients have financial situations and repayment sources different from the general public, so banks should treat them like corporate customers, granting an overall credit limit based on the client’s total credit profile and checking it across banks via the Financial Joint Credit Information Center system. Each bank can set its own credit tightness according to its risk appetite, as long as the collateral is acceptable, but the strict rule prohibiting urging customers to borrow for investment will be firmly enforced.

On the virtual‑asset side, the association has already submitted draft provisions for a stablecoin‑issuance sub‑law to the FSC, while custodial‑service guidelines are still under development. Although outsiders see banks’ reserve‑backed advantage as a potential driver for stablecoin issuance, Dong bluntly stated that a New Taiwan Dollar stablecoin has little significance and national banks have very low willingness to issue one.

Dong identified three practical concerns: first, a New Taiwan Dollar stablecoin lacks international circulation; second, domestic inter‑bank transfer channels are already extremely convenient, leaving few real‑world use cases; third, Taiwanese banks lack the technology, manpower and economies of scale, making the cost of building and maintaining a blockchain system prohibitively high with no scale benefits.

What national banks really want is to wait for major U.S. banks such as JPMorgan or Citi to launch a US‑dollar stablecoin, then connect Taiwanese banks to it and offer unlimited exchange to Taiwan’s import‑export firms – essentially a digital bank travel‑cheque. Dong analyzed that the current B2C model via virtual‑asset exchanges handles transaction sizes of only up to about NT$2 million, far too small to meet the trade‑settlement needs of large exporters like TSMC (2330‑TW) that may require tens of millions of dollars. The banks’ battlefield is B2B; using an internationally trusted US‑dollar stablecoin is the only way to create real business opportunities.

Addressing recent market concerns about banks’ liquidity coverage ratio (LCR) and tight funding, Dong shared frontline observations. He noted that yields on central‑bank treasury bills, negotiable certificates of deposit (NCDs) and secondary‑market commercial paper (CP2) have risen across the board, indicating that even though the central bank has not yet changed policy rates, the market’s funding tightness is already reflected in rates, similar to how U.S. Treasury yields move ahead of Federal Reserve decisions. In response, banks’ most direct action is to actively attract deposits to shore up liquidity.

Regarding Chairman Peng Jin‑long’s remarks at the FSC meeting about promoting “trust finance,” “all‑age finance,” “financial resilience,” and “financial feedback,” Dong said the association will actively push for institutionalized and differentiated financial feedback. He stressed that financial feedback should not be a uniform charity or rate cut by all banks, but should feature distinctive approaches.

Dong, who also serves as chairman of Mega International Commercial Bank, cited his own bank’s vigorous promotion of Mini Baseball for children under 12 nationwide, donating safe equipment to about 1 500 of roughly 3 000 elementary schools. He urged all banks to submit their annual financial‑feedback plans to their boards for discussion, treating charitable contributions with the same seriousness as business initiatives, so that public‑welfare activities become long‑term, systematic and institutionalized.

items.title: 各國指標鋼廠挺價+需求陸續釋出 中鴻11月內銷、12月外銷盤價順勢調漲
items.title_en: Key Steel Mills Abroad Hold Prices as Demand Gradually Emerges; Zhong Hong Raises Domestic November and Export December Prices
paras: 中鴻(2014-TW)今(14)日開出11月內銷及12月外銷盤價，當前鋼市供需結構持續調整，核心煉鋼原料對成本支撐仍強，且各國指標鋼廠挺價意願強烈，考量下游外貿接單及補庫需求陸續釋出，為反映鋼市現況並提振市場信心，盤價順勢調漲，內銷熱軋、冷軋、鍍鋅每公噸漲900元，外銷依產品及地區別調漲，實際報價視當地市場行情而定。
鋼鐵供需方面，中國鋼協（CISA）公布九月下旬數據顯示，重點鋼企日均粗鋼產量環比下降 2.1%、鋼材庫存量顯著下降 8.4%，顯示供給端調控與去庫進程順暢。此外，日本JFE Steel因先前極端天氣影響減產約60萬噸，加上韓國POSCO光陽廠高爐將於11月進行熄火大修，預計區域現貨供給將趨於收斂，支撐亞洲鋼市維持正向發展。
總體經濟方面，國際貨幣基金組織（IMF）最新《世界經濟展望》報告指出，受惠於 AI 相關投資需求帶動，全球經濟在中東局勢與貿易緊張下仍具韌性，預期2026年全球經濟成長上調至 3.1% ，並於2027年反彈至 3.4%。另，標普全球（S&P Global）九月全球製造業PMI升至53.0，創2022年二月以來新高，反映全球製造業景氣亦持續改善。
paras_en: Zhong Hong (2014‑TW) announced today (the 14th) its November domestic and December export price lists. With the steel market’s supply‑demand structure still adjusting, core steel‑making raw materials continue to support costs, and major steel mills in various countries are keen to hold prices. Considering that downstream foreign‑trade orders and inventory‑replenishment needs are being released, the company raised its listed prices to reflect current market conditions and boost confidence: domestic hot‑rolled, cold‑rolled and galvanized steel each increase by NT$900 per tonne, while export prices are adjusted by product and region, with actual quotations depending on local market conditions.

Regarding steel supply and demand, data released by the China Iron and Steel Association (CISA) for late September show that key Chinese steel producers’ daily crude steel output fell 2.1% month‑on‑month and steel inventories dropped sharply by 8.4%, indicating smooth supply‑side regulation and inventory reduction. In addition, Japan’s JFE Steel, hit by extreme weather, cut output by about 600,000 tonnes, and South Korea’s POSCO Guangyang plant will shut its blast furnace for major maintenance in November, so regional spot supply is expected to tighten, supporting a positive outlook for the Asian steel market.

On the macro‑economic front, the International Monetary Fund’s latest World Economic Outlook notes that, buoyed by AI‑related investment demand, the global economy remains resilient despite Middle‑East tensions and trade frictions, with 2026 global growth now projected at 3.1% and a rebound to 3.4% in 2027. Meanwhile, S&P Global reported that the September global manufacturing PMI rose to 53.0, the highest since February 2022, indicating continued improvement in worldwide manufacturing activity.

items.title: 施羅德首檔主動式ETF 00419A於11/2開募 10元甜甜價搶搭台股AI浪潮
items.title_en: Schroders Launches First Active ETF 00419A on Nov 2 at NT$10 to Ride Taiwan AI Wave
paras: 全球資產管理巨頭施羅德投信今（14）日宣布，正式將主動式ETF版圖延伸至台灣，推出深耕台灣近40年來的首檔主動式ETF「施羅德AI科技台股主動式ETF」 (00419A-TW) 。該基金預計於 11 月 2 日至 11 月 6 日進行募集，發行價格為新台幣 10 元，最低申購門檻僅需 1 萬元，並採季配息（預定 3/6/9/12 月）且導入收益平準金機制，滿足投資人追求資本利得與現金流的需求。
截至 2026 年 8 月底，施羅德在台管理資產規模已達新台幣 5,673 億元。施羅德投信董事長謝誠晃表示：「台灣不僅是全球科技產業重鎮，也是亞洲最活躍、發展最迅速的ETF市場之一。ETF架構兼具靈活性與高透明度，而主動式管理能讓我們適時因應市場變化、發掘潛在的新興贏家，建構高信心的投資組合。」
施羅德全球ETF主管 Tom Stephen 亦指出，台灣企業處於半導體創新與下一代科技發展的最前線，隨著AI應用加速滲透，產業鏈蘊含極大的投資潛力。本次結合施羅德全球橫跨 24 個地區、逾 650 位專業投資人的研究平台，將發揮深厚的台股選股實力。
針對投資人最關心的選股策略，施羅德台股團隊00419A基金經理人游信凱於記者會上直言，這一波AI浪潮與過去產業景氣循環不同，而是「產品規格升級帶來的選擇性成長週期」。隨著雲端服務商（CSP）資本支出持續激增，預估明年資本支出將突破 1.06 兆美元，AI 算力對於基礎建設的要求已不可同日而語。
游信凱進一步分析，當前單一晶片功耗大幅提升，一架AI伺服器機櫃的功耗動輒高達 125 千瓦（kW），「這相當於一棟大樓的用電量在持續運轉！」因此，龐大的發熱與耗電需求，將帶動電源供應、散熱模組（如液冷技術）、電力基礎建設與重電族群的強勁規格升級需求。
00419A 將從超過 300 檔AI相關企業中，精選出 30 檔以上的優質個股，三大核心佈局方向包含：
關鍵零組件與半導體：包含先進製程、先進封裝（CoWoS）、IC設計與高速傳輸。
基礎建設與電力散熱：涵蓋散熱模組、重電設備與不斷電系統等算力支援供應鏈。
新型AI應用與軟硬整合：延伸至邊緣AI、機器人開發及新軟體應用等未來十年的潛力領域。
面對市場關注主動式ETF如何擊敗大盤，施羅德團隊強調，台股科技產業並非所有公司都能吃到訂單，唯有能夠滿足科技大廠嚴格規格要求的企業才能脫穎而出。團隊每天透過嚴謹的基本面分析與評判，尋找具備產品升級能力與獲利上修潛力的個股。
游信凱指出：「我們追求的是長期績效表現與高信念的投資佈局，而非短線跟風。透過團隊合作與徹底的基本面功課，協助投資人不僅能喝到AI浪潮的『肉湯』，更能精準抓到最核心的獲利主軸。」
施羅德AI科技台股主動式ETF (00419A) 將於 11 月 2 日正式募集，風險報酬等級為 RR5，提供投資人以小額資金靈活卡位全球AI供應鏈核心的絕佳工具。
paras_en: Global asset manager Schroders Investment Trust announced today (the 14th) that it is formally extending its active‑ETF footprint to Taiwan with the launch of its first active ETF focused on Taiwan, the Schroders AI Technology Taiwan Stock Active ETF (00419A‑TW). The fund is slated to raise capital from November 2 to November 6, with an issue price of NT$10 per unit, a minimum subscription of NT$10,000, quarterly distributions (scheduled for March, June, September and December) and a yield‑smoothing mechanism to meet investors’ desires for both capital gains and cash flow.

As of the end of August 2026, Schroders’ assets under management in Taiwan total NT$567.3 billion. Schroders Investment Trust Chairman Hsieh Cheng‑Huang said, “Taiwan is not only a global technology hub but also one of the most active and fastest‑growing ETF markets in Asia. The ETF structure offers flexibility and high transparency, while active management lets us respond to market changes and uncover emerging winners, building a high‑conviction portfolio.”

Schroders Global ETF head Tom Stephen also noted that Taiwanese companies sit at the forefront of semiconductor innovation and next‑generation technology development. With AI applications accelerating, the supply chain holds huge investment potential. This launch leverages Schroders’ global research platform spanning 24 regions and more than 650 professional investors to apply deep Taiwan‑stock stock‑picking expertise.

Addressing investors’ top concern—stock‑selection strategy—Schroders Taiwan‑stock team manager Yu Hsin‑Kai said at the press conference that this AI wave differs from past industry cycles, representing a “selective growth cycle driven by product‑spec upgrades.” With cloud‑service providers’ capital expenditures surging, next year’s capex is projected to exceed $1.06 trillion, and AI compute power demands on infrastructure are now incomparable to the past.

Yu further explained that today a single AI chip’s power consumption has risen sharply; an AI server rack can draw as much as 125 kW, “equivalent to the electricity usage of an entire building running continuously!” This massive heat and power demand will drive strong upgrades in power‑supply units, cooling modules (such as liquid‑cooling technology), power‑grid infrastructure and heavy‑electric equipment sectors.
The 00419A fund will select more than 30 high‑quality stocks from over 300 AI‑related companies, focusing on three core thematic pillars:
Key components and semiconductors, including advanced processes, advanced packaging (CoWoS), IC design and high‑speed interconnects.
Infrastructure and power‑thermal solutions, covering cooling modules, heavy‑electric equipment and uninterruptible power systems that support compute power supply chains.
New AI applications and hardware‑software integration, extending to edge AI, robotics development and emerging software uses that represent potential growth areas over the next decade.

When asked how an active ETF can outperform the broader market, the Schroders team emphasized that not every Taiwan tech firm will capture orders; only those that meet the stringent specifications of major tech manufacturers can stand out. The team conducts rigorous daily fundamental analysis to identify companies with product‑upgrade capabilities and upside earnings‑revision potential.

Yu Hsin‑Kai added, “We aim for long‑term performance and high‑conviction positioning, not short‑term hype. Through teamwork and thorough fundamental research, we help investors not only sip the ‘broth’ of the AI wave but also pinpoint the core profit drivers with precision.”

The Schroders AI Technology Taiwan Stock Active ETF (00419A) will officially commence fundraising on November 2, carries a risk‑return rating of RR5, and offers investors a low‑cost, flexible way to gain exposure to the core of the global AI supply chain.

items.title: 大量科技上半年賺回近一股本 9月純益3.52億元單月EPS 3.82元
items.title_en: Dahli Technology's H1 Earnings Near One Share Capital; September Net Profit NT$352 million, Monthly EPS NT$3.82

paras_en: Demand for back‑drilling machines has surged due to AI thick‑plate applications, and Dahli Technology (3167‑TW) has a full order book.
